summary_1line: The vulture Sampati recounts Jatayu’s fate and reveals that Ravana carried Sita to Lanka across the southern sea.

image_candidates.scene_text: Wingless Sampati stands on a rocky height telling the gathered monkeys how he saw Ravana carrying Sita across the sky.
In the blazing sky of the past, Sampati spreads his wings over the fainting Jatayu as they fly too close to the sun.
Ravana flies through the air with the crying Sita in his arms as she throws down her ornaments toward the earth below.
